case.summary: Transaction 3506725 ($1000.03, online, product code R) was flagged by the bank's model at score 0.90. The transaction matches the card_not_present_new_device pattern: it occurred on a Windows device marked as new to the account, and the $1000.03 amount is four times the cardholder's median transaction of $90.00 across 36 prior transactions. Prior case memory returned 8 structurally similar cases in the same billing region and pattern, all 8 confirmed as fraud with exposures ranging from $49.93 to $2449.72. The cardholder was contacted and denied making this transaction while still holding the card. Assessment concludes fraud with probability 0.86 and recommends card block. Confidence is high based on pattern consistency across prior closed cases, transaction anomaly relative to established behavior, and customer denial.

sar.narrative: Customer C10434 holds card C10434-K1 and conducted a $1,000.03 online transaction on December 2, 2016 at 15:18:27 UTC from a device profile marked as new to the account (Windows 10, Edge 16.0, 1366x768 resolution). The transaction occurred in billing region 469.0 using product code R, a card-not-present channel. The cardholder's historical transaction profile shows 36 transactions spanning six billing regions between July and December 2016, with a median transaction amount of $90.00 across both online and in-person channels. The flagged transaction of $1,000.03 exceeds this median by more than four times. The bank's real-time model assigned a risk score of 0.90 to this transaction. The transaction matches the card-not-present-new-device pattern, which combines an online purchase with a device the identity system marks as new for this account. Eight structurally similar cases retrieved from the same region and pattern were confirmed as fraud, with zero false alarms. When contacted, the cardholder denied authorizing this transaction and confirmed the card remains in their possession. The total suspicious amount is $1,000.03. The bank created a case record, blocked the card, and filed a suspicious activity report.
